items.question: Which organisations published the Life after COVID-19 publications in the UAE government's COVID-19 resources?
items.gold: Dubai Future Foundation, Dubai Government Human Resources Department and Gulf Health Council.
items.fact: Three organisations published the Life after COVID-19 publications

items.question: When was the Life after COVID-19 publications page on the UAE government website last updated?
items.fact: Life after COVID-19 page was last updated 25 November 2025
